tags.name: Rotorblatt

estimates: Complete retained OSM plans. New museum top25.879 uses the official flat-campus maximum in the unchanged NHN-30 frame, not an independently surveyed storey profile. Main ground and both shed eaves retain the existing viewer datum. First shed ridge, facade subdivisions, glass fields, suspended aircraft altitude, fittings and six anonymous museum locomotives are display estimates. Second shed source top14.914 retained. Rotor44m is published by the operator.

references.author: Stiftung Deutsches Technikmuseum Berlin; exterior photograph Ériver Hijano; park photograph C. Kirchner
references.claim: Existing four-storey new museum by Ulrich Wolff / Helge Pitz; suspended Douglas C-47B; former Anhalter railway works, two railway exhibition halls, old entrance and separate Spectrum. Planned new reception is not built here.

references.author: Stiftung Deutsches Technikmuseum Berlin; photographs Ériver Hijano / C. Kirchner
references.claim: The upright Vestas V90 blade is 44 m long; two distinct working windmills survive in the museum park.

references.author: Stiftung Deutsches Technikmuseum Berlin; photographs Ériver Hijano
references.claim: Two historic roundhouses and their outdoor turntables, glazed inner circulation, 40 original railway vehicles and the surviving Fürstenportal. Six generic static locomotive interpretations are not asserted to identify six current display bays or inventory numbers.
